title: Preserve constructor TypeError in Version.replace
test_code:
import pytest
from semver import Version

def test_replace_preserves_constructor_type_error():
    v = Version.parse('1.2.3')
    with pytest.raises(TypeError) as excinfo:
        v.replace(major=None)
    assert '0 unexpected keyword' not in str(excinfo.value)
expected_behavior: v.replace(major=None) preserves constructor TypeError without saying 'got 0 unexpected keyword argument(s)'
actual_behavior: AssertionError: assert '0 unexpected keyword' not in "replace() got 0 unexpected keyword argument(s): "

title: Raise Invalid for non-numeric input to Number validator
test_code:
import pytest
from voluptuous import Schema, Number, Invalid

def test_number_validation_non_numeric():
    schema = Schema({'number': Number(precision=6, scale=2)})
    with pytest.raises(Invalid):
        schema({'number': None})
expected_behavior: Number validator raises Invalid for non-numeric input (None)
